verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only one-off crawl execution: arun calls, CLI deep crawls, and long-running crawls with crash recovery via resume_state. A Dockerized server is a deployment option, not an automation feature. Nothing documents scheduled, recurring, or autonomous background automations, and the community pairing with n8n is an external-tool workaround that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
